name: BVG Design Services
brand_truth: They were getting Bahamian businesses found online before most of the Bahamas was online, starting with their own Bahamas Vacation Guide in 1996.
buyer: Owners of small and mid Bahamian businesses and tourism operators on Grand Bahama, Nassau and Abaco, budget-conscious, wanting a local firm that answers the phone.

design.signature: Live browser that types a Bahamian search and assembles a site in the Bahamian flag colours; 1996-vs-today drag compare of the Bahamas Vacation Guide; office chart of the islands

current_site_findings: Own site says 'Last Updated on 30 May, 2014'
Advertising agency page link is a 404
No mobile layout, bold text and GIF buttons
Two phone numbers and two emails in public
30-year track record buried in a joke paragraph
pitch_line: You put the Bahamas online in 1996, but your own site stopped in 2014: here is what BVG looks like when it practices what it sells.
assumptions: Nassau and Abaco offices still active (from 2014 site)
Advertising services (print, video, disc production) still offered
Simple pages within 24 hours still holds
notes: Record said no own site; research found bvgdesign.com (last updated 2014), so Track A. Prospect is itself a web design firm: pitch as a modernisation/partnership, not a beginner sale. 2014 prices deliberately not shown. Hero browser shows a clearly labelled example build ('Your business, Lucaya'), not a client. Logo hotlinked from bvgdesign.com inside the 1996 recreation. Scorecard: hero 4, type 5, layout 4, context 4, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 4, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 4, consistency 4. Remaining warning: some small tap targets (inline links) on mobile. Services page has no interactive widgets; home has 4.
